description: E2 (decision E2-4): a fang of grey rock 22 m tall leaning over the Cut, the crack in the Ash-pit's west lip its water drained out through. Only a stage-9 giant (116 ft) can heave it over: it falls across the Cut and dams it, and the springs fill the pit again (world.ashfell.dammed) - water deep enough to put the Cinder Titan on his knee in the steam. A smaller giant cannot move it.
locked_message: It will not move. Only a giant of a hundred and sixteen feet could heave it over. Grow to stage 9.
